name: WorkFlex
what: Automates compliance for business travel, workations and remote work abroad (visas, A1/PWD certificates, tax, duty of care).
homonym_note: Not the US 'WorkFlex' state waiver programme that shows up in Google News.

membership.basis: Live visionaries.vc portfolio; WorkFlex's own growth-round post names Visionaries Club as a backer.
membership.quote: The company is backed by Spectrum Equity, Visionaries Club, s16vc

funding_rounds.round: Growth investment (called Series B by Startup in Europe)

notes: The only dated round is the EUR 37M growth investment of 2026-03-17 (vestbee: 'with additional support from Visionaries Club and s16vc'), which reads as existing backers joining; the earlier round(s) in which Visionaries entered are not reported anywhere found (Google News '"WorkFlex" raises', '"WorkFlex" seed', '"WorkFlex" Amsterdam', '"WorkFlex" Visionaries'; eu-startups page 403). A web-search summary claimed 'Visionaries Club has been with the company since pre-seed' but the page carrying it could not be fetched, so entry stays undetermined. Startup in Europe calls the EUR 37M round 'Series B'. Founded 2022 per the company post (vendors say 2021). Visionaries listed WorkFlex only on the 2026 site, not on the 2023-2025 captures.
